problem:
Calculate the minor of the entry ${b}_{22}$ in the matrix
$B=[\begin{aligned}3 & 13 & -6 \\ 2 & 7 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}].$
worked_solution:
The minor of ${b}_{22}=7$ (second row, second column) is the determinant of the remaining entries when the column and row containing $7$ are removed: 

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}3 & ∗ & -6 \\ ∗ & 7 & ∗ \\ 5 & ∗ & 4\end{aligned}]
$$

 

So, the minor of ${b}_{22}=7$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{det}[\begin{aligned}3 & -6 \\ 5 & 4\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}3 & -6 \\ 5 & 4\end{aligned}| \\  & =3\cdot 4-(-6)\cdot 5 \\  & =12-(-30) \\  & =42.\end{aligned}
$$
